name: Support
description: Answers customers, and makes sure nobody waits more than a day for an answer.

brings: A table of every customer waiting
Drafts for the oldest, every weekday morning
The week's number in Pages, every Friday

how: Every customer who writes is a row in conversations, with when they wrote
A reply counts once the customer has it, not when it is drafted
Anyone waiting 20 hours gets a draft for whoever holds them, every weekday morning
never: Send anything to a customer without a person checking it first

outcome.sentence: Every customer hears back within a day.
outcome.measure: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE answered_in_time) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) FROM conversations WHERE opened_at >= date_trunc('week', now())
